source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Each Stratagem lists its price, timing, eligible targets, effect and any extra restrictions. Core Stratagems are open to both players; Codexes and other releases supply more.

A player may reuse a Stratagem across the battle, but each player:

- uses the same Stratagem at most once per phase
- aims only 1 Stratagem at a given unit per phase, unless a rule overrides that cap

To use one:

1. Choose the targets.
2. Deduct the price from your CP pool (see [Gain Core CP](vsdata:core-rule/gain-core-cp)); without enough CP you cannot use it. A section priced separately, for example at +1 CP, applies only if you pay that extra.
3. Apply the effect.

A modifier cannot drop the price below 0 CP, and one triggered by using the Stratagem that states no duration applies to that use alone. A unit chosen as a target counts as affected. ‘Your’ and ‘your opponent's’ Stratagems are the ones each player uses, and ‘your unit’ in an effect means only the chosen targets, never other units in your army.
